title: Meeting Prep with AI Agent Skills: A Practical Workflow
summary: Use recent research skills to prepare for calls with fresher context than static profile pages can provide.
author: OpenAgent.bot Editors
seoTitle: Meeting Prep with AI Agent Skills
seoDescription: A practical workflow for using AI agent skills such as last30days to prepare for meetings with recent public context.
body: Good meeting prep is not only reading a company website. It is understanding what changed recently.
[last30days](/skills/last30days-skill) is useful here because it can search recent public signals about a person, company, product, or market before a call.
- Search the person, company, and product category.
- Look for recent launches, posts, interviews, repository activity, or community reactions.
- Pull out three likely priorities and three thoughtful questions.
- Verify factual claims against official pages before using them.
- Keep the final brief short enough to read before the call.
Do not treat social posts as private insight. Do not over-personalize from one noisy thread. Do not mention facts you have not verified.
A useful prep brief has recent context, open questions, possible objections, and source links. It should make the conversation warmer and sharper without feeling invasive.
